417: func runtimeEventDraft(req runtimepkg.Request, event runtimepkg.Event) runcontrol.EventDraft {
418: 	eventType := runcontrol.EventProgress
419: 	lowerType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Type))
420: 	lowerKind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(event.Kind))
421: 	switch lowerType {
422: 	case "warning", "warn", "error":
423: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventWarning
424: 	case "artifact", "file":
425: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventArtifact
426: 	case "finding":
427: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventFinding
428: 	case "message", "text", "output", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text", "reasoning", "content", "delta":
429: 		eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
430: 	default:
431: 		// Kind-based fallback: reasoning and message kinds should be visible as message, not coalesced progress.
432: 		switch lowerKind {
433: 		case "message", "reasoning", "assistant", "assistant_text", "reasoning_text":
434: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventMessage
435: 		case "tool", "tool_use", "tool_call", "tool_call_update":
436: 			// Tools stay as progress but with distinct payload so coalescing can distinguish.
437: 			eventType = runcontrol.EventProgress
438: 		}
439: 	}
440: 	payload := map[string]string{
441: 		"runtime_event_id": boundedSafe(event.ID),
442: 		"runtime_run_id":   boundedSafe(event.RunID),
443: 		"session_id":       boundedSafe(event.SessionID),
444: 		"type":             boundedSafe(event.Type),
445: 		"kind":             boundedSafe(event.Kind),
446: 	}
447: 	if lowerKind == "tool" || lowerKind == "tool_use" || lowerKind == "tool_call" || lowerKind == "tool_call_update" {
448: 		captureToolObservation(payload, event.Payload)
449: 	}
450: 	// Preserve safe observable payload fields into durable storage for observability.
451: 	// Deny sensitive keys and truncate values to runcontrol-safe limits.
452: 	// Flatten one level of nesting so tool/action names buried in maps are surfaced as top-level payload keys
453: 	// that the run timeline JS expects (payload.tool, payload.action, payload.title, etc.).
454: 	for key, value := range event.Payload {
455: 		if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
456: 			continue
457: 		}
458: 		normalized := strings.TrimSpace(key)
459: 		if normalized == "" || len(normalized) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(normalized, "\x00\r\n") {
460: 			continue
461: 		}
462: 		if normalized == "type" || normalized == "kind" {
463: 			continue
464: 		}
465: 		if nested, ok := value.(map[string]any); ok {
466: 			for subKey, subVal := range nested {
467: 				if isSensitivePayloadKey(subKey) {
468: 					continue
469: 				}
470: 				subNorm := strings.TrimSpace(subKey)
471: 				if subNorm == "" || len(subNorm) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(subNorm, "\x00\r\n") {
472: 					continue
473: 				}
474: 				if _, exists := payload[subNorm]; exists {
475: 					continue
476: 				}
477: 				// Promote common observable sub-keys; namespace the rest to avoid collisions.
478: 				promote := map[string]bool{"tool": true, "title": true, "detail": true, "text": true, "delta": true, "content": true, "message": true, "action": true, "state": true, "status": true, "native_type": true, "line": true}
479: 				targetKey := subNorm
480: 				if !promote[subNorm] {
481: 					targetKey = normalized + "_" + subNorm
482: 					if len(targetKey) > 128 {
483: 						continue
484: 					}
485: 				}
486: 				if _, exists := payload[targetKey]; exists {
487: 					continue
488: 				}
489: 				str := payloadValueString(subVal)
490: 				if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
491: 					continue
492: 				}
493: 				if len(payload) >= 30 {
494: 					break
495: 				}
496: 				payload[targetKey] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
497: 			}
498: 			// Also keep a compact stringified top-level for debugging if not promoted.
499: 			if len(payload) < 30 {
500: 				if _, exists := payload[normalized]; !exists {
501: 					str := payloadValueString(value)
502: 					if strings.TrimSpace(str) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(str, "[map omitted") {
503: 						payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
504: 					}
505: 				}
506: 			}
507: 			continue
508: 		}
509: 		str := payloadValueString(value)
510: 		if strings.TrimSpace(str) == "" {
511: 			continue
512: 		}
513: 		if len(payload) >= 30 {
514: 			break
515: 		}
516: 		if _, exists := payload[normalized]; exists {
517: 			continue
518: 		}
519: 		payload[normalized] = boundedPayloadValue(str)
520: 	}
521: 	// Ensure the most useful display keys are always present even if nested.
522: 	for _, want := range []string{"tool", "action", "title", "detail", "text", "delta"} {
523: 		if _, ok := payload[want]; ok {
524: 			continue
525: 		}
526: 		if v := findNestedString(event.Payload, want); v != "" {
527: 			payload[want] = boundedPayloadValue(v)
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	omission := (*runcontrol.Omission)(nil)
531: 	if event.RawPresent || event.RawOmitted {
532: 		reason := firstSafeValue(event.RawOmissionReason, "runtime payload omitted by safe persistence policy")
533: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe(reason), Count: 1}
534: 	} else if len(event.Payload) > len(payload)-5 {
535: 		// Payload had more fields than we persisted (truncated/omitted keys) – record for diagnostics but don't hide persisted fields.
536: 		omission = &runcontrol.Omission{Reason: boundedSafe("runtime payload truncated to safe observable fields"), Count: 1}
537: 	}
538: 	return runcontrol.EventDraft{
539: 		Type: eventType, Scope: runcontrol.EventScopeRuntime,
540: 		Stage: boundedSafe(req.Metadata["stage"]), Task: boundedSafe(firstSafeValue(req.Metadata["task"], req.Metadata["task.kind"])),
541: 		Kind: payload["kind"], Tool: payload["tool"], Action: payload["action"],
542: 		Reason: payload["reason"], Detail: firstSafeValue(payload["detail"], payload["title"]),
543: 		Payload: payload, Omission: omission,
544: 	}
545: }
546: 
547: func isSensitivePayloadKey(key string) bool {
548: 	lower := strings.ToLower(key)
549: 	for _, marker := range []string{"secret", "token", "password", "authorization", "cookie", "api_key", "apikey", "credential", "auth"} {
550: 		if strings.Contains(lower, marker) {
551: 			return true
552: 		}
553: 	}
554: 	return false
555: }
556: 
557: func findNestedString(payload map[string]any, want string) string {
558: 	for _, v := range payload {
559: 		if m, ok := v.(map[string]any); ok {
560: 			if s, ok := m[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
561: 				return s
562: 			}
563: 			// One more level deep (common for opencode part.state structures)
564: 			for _, inner := range m {
565: 				if innerMap, ok := inner.(map[string]any); ok {
566: 					if s, ok := innerMap[want].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(s) != "" {
567: 						return s
568: 					}
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 		}
572: 	}
573: 	return ""
574: }
575: 
576: func payloadValueString(value any) string {
577: 	switch v := value.(type) {
578: 	case string:
579: 		return v
580: 	case []byte:
581: 		if len(v) == 0 {
582: 			return ""
583: 		}
584: 		return string(v)
585: 	case bool:
586: 		if v {
587: 			return "true"
588: 		}
589: 		return "false"
590: 	case int:
591: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
592: 	case int8:
593: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
594: 	case int16:
595: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
596: 	case int32:
597: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
598: 	case int64:
599: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
600: 	case uint, uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64:
601: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%d", v)
602: 	case float32, float64:
603: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
604: 	case map[string]any, map[string]string, []any, []string:
605: 		// Encode structured values compactly.
606: 		encoded, err := jsonMarshalTruncated(v)
607: 		if err != nil {
608: 			return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
609: 		}
610: 		return encoded
611: 	default:
612: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
613: 	}
614: }
615: 
616: func jsonMarshalTruncated(v any) (string, error) {
617: 	encoded, err := json.Marshal(v)
618: 	if err != nil {
619: 		return "", err
620: 	}
621: 	return string(encoded), nil
622: }
623: 
624: func captureToolObservation(out map[string]string, payload map[string]any) {
625: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
626: 		"tool_call_id": {"tool_call_id", "toolCallId", "call_id", "callID"},
627: 		"tool_name":    {"tool_name", "toolName", "tool", "name"},
628: 		"tool_status":  {"tool_status", "status", "phase"},
629: 	} {
630: 		if value := findNestedPayloadValue(payload, aliases, 0); value != nil {
631: 			if text, ok := value.(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(text) != "" {
632: 				out[target] = boundedPayloadValue(text)
633: 			}
634: 		}
635: 	}
636: 	for target, aliases := range map[string][]string{
637: 		"tool_arguments": {"tool_arguments", "arguments", "args", "input", "parameters"},
638: 		"tool_result":    {"tool_result", "result", "output", "content"},
639: 		"tool_error":     {"tool_error", "error"},
640: 	} {
641: 		value := findNestedPayloadValue(payload, aliases, 0)
642: 		if value == nil {
643: 			continue
644: 		}
645: 		encoded, err := json.Marshal(redactObservableValue(value))
646: 		if err == nil && string(encoded) != "null" {
647: 			out[target] = boundedPayloadValue(string(encoded))
648: 		}
649: 	}
650: 	if out["tool"] == "" {
651: 		out["tool"] = out["tool_name"]
652: 	}
653: }
654: 
655: func findNestedPayloadValue(value any, aliases []string, depth int) any {
656: 	if depth > 5 {
657: 		return nil
658: 	}
659: 	switch typed := value.(type) {
660: 	case map[string]any:
661: 		for _, key := range aliases {
662: 			if found, ok := typed[key]; ok && found != nil {
663: 				return found
664: 			}
665: 		}
666: 		keys := make([]string, 0, len(typed))
667: 		for key := range typed {
668: 			keys = append(keys, key)
669: 		}
670: 		sort.Strings(keys)
671: 		for _, key := range keys {
672: 			if found := findNestedPayloadValue(typed[key], aliases, depth+1); found != nil {
673: 				return found
674: 			}
675: 		}
676: 	case []any:
677: 		for _, item := range typed {
678: 			if found := findNestedPayloadValue(item, aliases, depth+1); found != nil {
679: 				return found
680: 			}
681: 		}
682: 	}
683: 	return nil
684: }
685: 
686: func redactObservableValue(value any) any {
687: 	switch typed := value.(type) {
688: 	case map[string]any:
689: 		redacted := make(map[string]any, len(typed))
690: 		for key, item := range typed {
691: 			if isSensitivePayloadKey(key) {
692: 				redacted[key] = "[REDACTED]"
693: 			} else {
694: 				redacted[key] = redactObservableValue(item)
695: 			}
696: 		}
697: 		return redacted
698: 	case []any:
699: 		redacted := make([]any, len(typed))
700: 		for index, item := range typed {
701: 			redacted[index] = redactObservableValue(item)
702: 		}
703: 		return redacted
704: 	case string:
705: 		lower := strings.ToLower(typed)

608: func (r *SQLiteRepository) Append(ctx context.Context, fence Fence, draft EventDraft) (eventResult Event, snapshotResult Snapshot, resultErr error) {
609: 	metricStarted := time.Now()
610: 	defer func() { r.metrics.append.observe(metricStarted, resultErr) }()
611: 	if ctx == nil {
612: 		ctx = context.Background()
613: 	}
614: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
615: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
616: 	}
617: 	draft = sanitizeEventDraft(NormalizeEventDraft(draft))
618: 	if usage, err := r.storageBytes(); err != nil {
619: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
620: 	} else if usage >= r.retention.HardQuotaBytes && !reservedEventType(draft.Type) {
621: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeQuota, "append_quota", fence.RunID, "hard quota permits only reserved lifecycle recovery writes", true, nil)
622: 	}
623: 	if err := validateEventDraft(draft); err != nil {
624: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
625: 	}
626: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(draft.Payload, MaxSafeValueBytes*8)
627: 	if err != nil {
628: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
629: 	}
630: 	var omissionJSON any
631: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
632: 		encoded, err := marshalBounded(draft.Omission, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
633: 		if err != nil {
634: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
635: 		}
636: 		omissionJSON = encoded
637: 	}
638: 	now := r.now()
639: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
640: 	if err != nil {
641: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
642: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, ctxErr
643: 		}
644: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_begin", "begin event append failed", err)
645: 	}
646: 	defer tx.Rollback()
647: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
648: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
649: 	}
650: 	var lastSequence uint64
651: 	var lifecycle string
652: 	if err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT last_sequence, lifecycle FROM runs WHERE run_id = ?`, string(fence.RunID)).Scan(&lastSequence, &lifecycle); err != nil {
653: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, mapRunLookupError("append", fence.RunID, err)
654: 	}
655: 	current := Lifecycle(lifecycle)
656: 	if current.IsTerminal() {
657: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeTerminal, "append", fence.RunID, "terminal run journal is immutable", false, nil)
658: 	}
659: 	nextLifecycle := current
660: 	if draft.Lifecycle != "" {
661: 		if !validActiveTransition(current, draft.Lifecycle) {
662: 			return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeInvariant, "append", fence.RunID, fmt.Sprintf("invalid lifecycle transition %s -> %s", current, draft.Lifecycle), false, nil)
663: 		}
664: 		nextLifecycle = draft.Lifecycle
665: 	}
666: 	sequence := lastSequence + 1
667: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
668: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, stage_id, task_id, payload_json, omission_json)
669: VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(draft.Type),
670: 		string(fence.AttemptID), draft.Stage, draft.Task, payload, omissionJSON); err != nil {
671: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_event", "persist ordered event failed", err)
672: 	}
673: 	omissionCount := uint64(0)
674: 	if draft.Omission != nil {
675: 		omissionCount = draft.Omission.Count
676: 	}
677: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
678: UPDATE runs SET last_sequence = ?, lifecycle = ?, omission_total = omission_total + ?, updated_at = ?
679: WHERE run_id = ? AND last_sequence = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
680: 		sequence, string(nextLifecycle), omissionCount, formatTime(now), string(fence.RunID), lastSequence, string(fence.AttemptID))
681: 	if err != nil {
682: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_snapshot", "update durable event snapshot failed", err)
683: 	}
684: 	if changed, err := result.RowsAffected(); err != nil || changed != 1 {
685: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, runError(CodeStaleFence, "append", fence.RunID, "event writer lost its authoritative fence", false, err)
686: 	}
687: 	if err := compactRunJournal(ctx, tx, fence.RunID, sequence); err != nil {
688: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
689: 	}
690: 	snapshot, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
691: 	if err != nil {
692: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
693: 	}
694: 	if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
695: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, err
696: 	}
697: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
698: 		return Event{}, Snapshot{}, classifyStoreError("append_commit", "commit ordered event failed", err)
699: 	}
700: 	event := Event{
701: 		RunID: fence.RunID, Sequence: sequence, CommittedAt: now, Type: draft.Type,
702: 		AttemptID: fence.AttemptID, Stage: draft.Stage, Task: draft.Task,
703: 		Payload: clonePayload(draft.Payload), Omission: cloneOmission(draft.Omission),
704: 	}
705: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
706: 	r.log(ctx, LogDebug, "run event committed",
707: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
708: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "event_type", Value: string(draft.Type)},
709: 		LogField{Key: "lifecycle", Value: string(snapshot.Lifecycle)})
710: 	return event, snapshot, nil
711: }

723: 	metricStarted := time.Now()

726: 		ctx = context.Background()

728: 	if err := fence.Validate(); err != nil {
729: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
730: 	}
731: 	if !proposal.Outcome.IsValid() {
732: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal.outcome", "is unknown")
733: 	}
734: 	if len(proposal.Reason) > MaxSafeValueBytes || len(proposal.ProposedBy) > MaxSafeValueBytes {
735: 		return Snapshot{}, false, invalidField("terminal", "contains an unbounded reason or proposer")

738: 	tx, err := r.db.BeginTx(ctx, nil)
739: 	if err != nil {
740: 		if ctxErr := ctx.Err(); ctxErr != nil {
741: 			return Snapshot{}, false, ctxErr
742: 		}
743: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_begin", "begin terminal proposal failed", err)
744: 	}
745: 	defer tx.Rollback()
746: 	if err := verifyFence(ctx, tx, fence); err != nil {
747: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
748: 	}
749: 	current, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
750: 	if err != nil {
751: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
752: 	}
753: 	if current.Terminal != nil {

755: 			return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_read_commit", "finish terminal winner read failed", err)
756: 		}
757: 		return current, false, nil
758: 	}
759: 	sequence := current.LastSequence + 1
760: 	payload, err := marshalBounded(map[string]string{"outcome": string(proposal.Outcome), "reason": proposal.Reason}, MaxSafeValueBytes*2)
761: 	if err != nil {
762: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
763: 	}
764: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
765: INSERT INTO events (run_id, sequence, committed_at, event_type, attempt_id, payload_json)
766: VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'terminal', ?, ?)`, string(fence.RunID), sequence, formatTime(now), string(fence.AttemptID), payload); err != nil {
767: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_event", "persist terminal event failed", err)

769: 	result, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `
770: UPDATE runs
771: SET lifecycle = ?, liveness = ?, finished_at = ?, updated_at = ?, last_sequence = ?,
772:     terminal_outcome = ?, terminal_reason = ?, terminal_at = ?, terminal_proposed_by = ?
773: WHERE run_id = ? AND current_attempt_id = ? AND terminal_outcome IS NULL`,
774: 		string(proposal.Outcome.Lifecycle()), string(LivenessTerminal), formatTime(now), formatTime(now), sequence,
775: 		string(proposal.Outcome), proposal.Reason, formatTime(now), proposal.ProposedBy,
776: 		string(fence.RunID), string(fence.AttemptID))
777: 	if err != nil {
778: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "persist terminal winner failed", err)
779: 	}
780: 	changed, err := result.RowsAffected()
781: 	if err != nil {
782: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_cas", "inspect terminal winner failed", err)
783: 	}
784: 	if changed != 1 {
785: 		return Snapshot{}, false, runError(CodeStaleFence, "terminal_cas", fence.RunID, "terminal proposer lost its authoritative fence", false, nil)
786: 	}
787: 	if _, err := tx.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE attempts SET outcome = ? WHERE attempt_id = ? AND run_id = ? AND owner_id = ? AND fencing_generation = ?`,
788: 		string(proposal.Outcome), string(fence.AttemptID), string(fence.RunID), fence.OwnerID, fence.FencingGeneration); err != nil {
789: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_attempt", "persist attempt outcome failed", err)
790: 	}
791: 	winner, err := loadSnapshot(ctx, tx, fence.RunID)
792: 	if err != nil {
793: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
794: 	}
795: 	if err := winner.Validate(); err != nil {
796: 		return Snapshot{}, false, err
797: 	}
798: 	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
799: 		return Snapshot{}, false, classifyStoreError("terminal_commit", "commit terminal winner failed", err)
800: 	}
801: 	r.notify(fence.RunID, sequence)
802: 	r.log(ctx, LogInfo, "run terminal committed",
803: 		LogField{Key: "run_id", Value: string(fence.RunID)}, LogField{Key: "attempt_id", Value: string(fence.AttemptID)},
804: 		LogField{Key: "sequence", Value: strconv.FormatUint(sequence, 10)}, LogField{Key: "terminal_outcome", Value: string(proposal.Outcome)},
805: 		LogField{Key: "terminal_winner", Value: "true"})
806: 	return winner, true, nil
807: }

- Identity: runtime_event_id, runtime_run_id, session_id, type, kind — all allowed.
- Tool observation: tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_status, tool_arguments, tool_result, tool_error — all in allowlist. Also "tool" set at :650-652. Allowed.
- Generic loop: arbitrary keys from provider events! e.g. "part_id", "delta_text", whatever. The promote list: {tool,title,detail,text,delta,content,message,action,state,status,native_type,line} — of these, only tool/action/detail/state/status/message are in the storage allowlist. "title", "text", "delta", "content", "native_type", "line" are NOT in allowedEventPayloadFields → dropped at storage with omission count. Namespaced keys parent_child also dropped unless coincidentally in allowlist.

So most message content (text/delta/content) is silently dropped by the storage sanitizer and counted as "unsafe event detail omitted". Not a correctness break (omission recorded), but it means EventMessage events carry no text... The run timeline JS expects payload.text/delta? The app layer comment says "flatten one level ... that the run timeline JS expects (payload.tool, payload.action, payload.title...)". But storage drops title/text/delta/content! Hmm wait — is this surface's concern? It's a seam mismatch between app pipeline and runcontrol allowlist. Observable outcome: TUI/web timeline can't show text content; every such event gets omission metadata. Is that a defect? The design intends redaction-before-persistence; dropping display text may be intended fail-safe behavior ("raw payloads replaced with explicit omission"). The comment in run_control.go says these keys are promoted so "the run timeline JS expects" them — but they're then discarded by sanitize. That's an internal contradiction suggesting a real bug: either the allowlist should include title/text/delta/content/native_type/line or promotion shouldn't bother. Effect: observability degraded but explicit omissions keep honesty. Severity low-medium; it's more product-observability than spine correctness. Hmm, but wait — does anything else re-add? No.

No test covers the trailing-flush-on-cancelled-ctx path. My candidate #11 (persistence_lost mislabel on cancellation when coalesced omissions pending) has no counter-evidence yet. Let me now verify the runtime Event type and check how sprintRuntimeService wires OnEvent, to gauge reachability of progressOmitted > 0. Also check web/operations.go + tui/app.go + serve_commands.go + run_commands.go.

Actually wait — before that, one more critical check on the trailing flush: `appendRunEventWithRetry(runCtx, ...)` — even in the SUCCESS path where base.StartRun returned normally, runCtx is alive. Fine.

But there's ANOTHER subtle issue with the same flush: it runs while the control goroutine may concurrently be in setPersistenceErr → but flush checks persistenceErr==nil under eventMu; control's setPersistenceErr takes eventMu too. If control sets persistenceErr first → skip flush. If flush first and fails → persistenceErr set. Either way consistent.

And: `progressOmitted` is written by OnEvent under eventMu; flush reads under eventMu. OK.

Now — a DIFFERENT issue in the same vein for RecordOperationEvent manager tier: append uses adapter-supplied ctx = context.Background() per pack (web publishAppEvent / TUI emit). Let me verify TUI emit and web publish call sites to confirm ctx used.

Also check the QA fence heartbeat: `ownership.repository.Heartbeat(fenceCtx, ownership.fence, runControlLease)` — heartbeat AFTER terminal? In test, fence(token) called mid-run works. Post-finish heartbeat: Heartbeat requires `outcome IS NULL` on attempt (line 40) AND run terminal_outcome IS NULL (line 48). After finish, attempt.outcome set → RowsAffected 0 → CodeStaleFence error. So post-finish QA writes fail fenced — that's fail-closed correct behavior (sprint treats as ErrStaleFence?). Sprint side checkWriter returns fence error → QA publish fails after operation finished. Is that intended? "heartbeating survives outer-context cancellation for bounded post-run writes" — post-run writes DURING cancellation but BEFORE finish. After finish they fail. Probably intended fencing.

Hmm wait, actually there's a subtle bug candidate here: sprint QA writes happen inside RunQA which runs INSIDE accepted.Context. If the operation gets cancelled mid-run (ctx cancelled), sprint continues bounded cleanup writes calling fence(token) → heartbeat succeeds (run not yet terminal since FinishOperation happens later). Good design.

But what about the case where FinishOperation already ran while RunQA still executing? Can't—finish waits for RunQA return... Actually web/TUI finish only after runner returns. CLI finishDurableCLICommand after command completes. OK.

Now examine remaining wiring files.

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {

436: 	}

439: 		h.counters.projectionDrops.Add(1)

441: 	}
442: 	if len(data) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {

444: 			"operation_id": record.doc.ID, "time": h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {

491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))

494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {

512: 		h.mu.Lock()

514: 		h.mu.Unlock()

517: 		}

520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),

585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),

589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),
591: 		}}

611: 		clone.Result = &result

222: 	started := h.now().UTC()

279: func (h *operationHub) finish(record *operationRecord, result app.OperationResult, runErr error) {
280: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
281: 	h.mu.Lock()
282: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
283: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
284: 		return
285: 	}
286: 	state := "succeeded"
287: 	switch {
288: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), result.State == app.OperationCancelled:
289: 		state = "cancelled"
290: 	case runErr != nil, result.State == app.OperationFailed:
291: 		state = "failed"
292: 	case result.State == app.OperationPartial:
293: 		state = "interrupted"
294: 	}

300: 	h.counters.active.Add(-1)
301: 	h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
302: 	close(record.done)
303: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
304: 		close(subscriber.ch)
305: 		delete(record.subscribers, id)

376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {
377: 	h.mu.Lock()
378: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
379: 	h.reapLocked()

383: 	}

385: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)

389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),

393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,

398: 	for _, event := range record.events {
399: 		if event.ID > lastID {
400: 			replay = append(replay, event)

402: 	}

406: 		close(sub.ch)

409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}

415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {

491: 	}

493: 	for _, record := range records {

495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {

507: 	if !ok {

509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()

514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})

526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))
528: 		}
529: 	}

531: }

537: 	for _, record := range records {

540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}

552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)

556: 	}

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),
580: 		Content: safeProjectedText(result.Content, MaxTerminalResultBytes/2), Truncated: result.Truncated,

585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})
587: 	}

589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),

592: 	}

596: 		out.Truncated = true
597: 		out.Message = safeBoundedText(out.Message, 4096)

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
233: 			smoke, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
234: 			if err != nil {
235: 				return c, err
236: 			}
237: 			c.Scope = []string{"canonical containing smoke selection", smoke.ScopeKind + " " + smoke.Scope}
238: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE SMOKE PREFLIGHT; NO HARNESS INVOCATION"
239: 			break
240: 		}
241: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
242: 		if err != nil {
243: 			return c, err
244: 		}
245: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
246: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
247: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
248: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
384: 	}
385: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Suite != "smoke" {
386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")
387: 	}
388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")
390: 	}
391: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Task != "" {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite and shard focus are mutually exclusive")
393: 	}
394: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil
554: }

556: func normalizeOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) OperationRequest {
557: 	req.Project = strings.TrimSpace(req.Project)
558: 	req.Sprint = strings.TrimSpace(req.Sprint)
559: 	req.Study = strings.TrimSpace(req.Study)
560: 	req.Stage = strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage)
561: 	req.Task = strings.TrimSpace(req.Task)
562: 	req.Model = strings.TrimSpace(req.Model)
563: 	req.Level = strings.TrimSpace(req.Level)
564: 	req.Suite = strings.TrimSpace(req.Suite)
565: 	req.Test = strings.TrimSpace(req.Test)
566: 	req.Timeout = strings.TrimSpace(req.Timeout)
567: 	req.OverrideRationale = strings.TrimSpace(req.OverrideRationale)
568: 	req.ReviewFocus = normalizedStrings(req.ReviewFocus)

574: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
575: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
576: 		if value == "" {
577: 			continue
578: 		}
579: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
580: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
581: 		}
582: 		for _, r := range value {
583: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
584: 				continue
585: 			}
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	return nil
590: }

592: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
593: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
594: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
595: 	for _, value := range values {
596: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
597: 		if value == "" {
598: 			continue
599: 		}
600: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
601: 			continue
602: 		}
603: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
604: 		out = append(out, value)
605: 	}
606: 	sort.Strings(out)
607: 	return out
608: }

699: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
700: 	hash := sha256.New()
701: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
702: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
703: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
704: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
705: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
706: 			continue
707: 		}
708: 		if err != nil {
709: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
710: 		}
711: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
712: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
713: 		}
714: 		if info.IsDir() {
715: 			var files []string
716: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
717: 				if walkErr != nil {
718: 					return walkErr
719: 				}
720: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
721: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
722: 				}
723: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
724: 					files = append(files, item)
725: 				}
726: 				return nil
727: 			}); err != nil {
728: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
729: 			}
730: 			sort.Strings(files)
731: 			for _, item := range files {
732: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
733: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
734: 					return "", err
735: 				}
736: 			}
737: 			continue
738: 		}
739: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
740: 			return "", err
741: 		}
742: 	}
743: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
744: }

746: func hashOperationFile(hash interface{ Write([]byte) (int, error) }, path, rel string) error {
747: 	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)

750: 	}
751: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte("\x00" + rel + "\x00"))
752: 	_, _ = hash.Write(data)
753: 	return nil

788: 	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
789: 		r.State = OperationCancelled
790: 	} else {
791: 		r.State = OperationFailed
792: 	}
793: 	cause := displaySafe(err.Error())
794: 	code, category, guidance := "internal.error", "internal", "Inspect durable state and retry after correcting the reported cause."
795: 	if smokeErr, ok := sprint.AsSmokeError(err); ok {
796: 		code, category, guidance = smokeErr.Code, smokeErr.Category, smokeErr.Guidance
797: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
798: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "smoke", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "process" || category == "timeout"}
799: 		return r, err
800: 	}
801: 	if qaErr, ok := sprint.AsQAError(err); ok {
802: 		category = string(qaErr.Category)
803: 		code = "qa." + category
804: 		guidance = qaErr.Recovery
805: 		switch qaErr.Category {
806: 		case sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, sprint.QAErrorPersistenceFailure:
807: 			category = "runtime"
808: 		case sprint.QAErrorConflict:
809: 			category = "concurrency"
810: 		default:
811: 			category = "validation"
812: 		}
813: 		r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
814: 		r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "qa", Component: "sprint", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable || qaErr.Category == sprint.QAErrorConflict}
815: 		return r, err
816: 	}
817: 	var projectRef project.RefError
818: 	var sprintRef sprint.RefError
819: 	switch {
820: 	case errors.Is(err, context.Canceled):
821: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.cancelled", "cancellation", "Resume the operation when ready."
822: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrFlowStateUnsupported),
823: 		errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMissing), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateMalformed), errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrExecuteRunStateUnsupported),
824: 		errors.As(err, &projectRef), errors.As(err, &sprintRef), len(r.Findings) > 0:
825: 		code, category, guidance = "validation.reference", "validation", "Complete or repair the reported governed evidence, inspect validation findings, and retry."
826: 	case errors.Is(err, sprint.ErrVerificationConflict), errors.Is(err, ErrStaleOperation):
827: 		code, category, guidance = "workflow.locked", "concurrency", "Inspect the active or stale study lock before retrying."
828: 	}
829: 	r.Message = operationFailureMessage(category)
830: 	r.Error = &OperationError{Code: code, Category: category, Operation: "workflow.operation", Component: "app", Message: r.Message, Cause: cause, Guidance: guidance, Retryable: category == "runtime" || category == "concurrency"}
831: 	return r, err

913: 	}
914: 	result := ValidationOperationResult{Operation: "validate", Status: "valid"}
915: 	switch req.Subject {

924: 		for _, finding := range validation.Findings {
925: 			result.Findings = append(result.Findings, projectFinding(finding))
926: 		}
927: 	case ValidationStudy:

929: 		validation, err := study.NewService(u.root).ValidateStudy(ref)
930: 		if err != nil {

935: 		for _, check := range validation.Checks {

937: 				result.Findings = append(result.Findings, studyFinding(check))
938: 			}

970: 		}

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
233: 			smoke, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
234: 			if err != nil {
235: 				return c, err
236: 			}
237: 			c.Scope = []string{"canonical containing smoke selection", smoke.ScopeKind + " " + smoke.Scope}
238: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE SMOKE PREFLIGHT; NO HARNESS INVOCATION"
239: 			break
240: 		}
241: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
242: 		if err != nil {
243: 			return c, err
244: 		}
245: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
246: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
247: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
248: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
249: 			c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
250: 			c.Scope = []string{"one canonical smoke harness invocation", "one smoke.md and flow-state update"}
251: 			c.Warning = "RUNTIME + EXTERNAL HARNESS EVIDENCE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
252: 			break
253: 		}
254: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
255: 		if err != nil {
256: 			return c, err
257: 		}
258: 		if req.Task != "" {
259: 			owned := false
260: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
261: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
262: 			}
263: 			if !owned {
264: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
265: 			}
266: 		}
267: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
268: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
269: 		if req.Task != "" {
270: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
271: 		}
272: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
273: 	case OperationQARecover:
274: 		c.Mutates = true
275: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
276: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
277: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
281: 	case OperationFlow:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
285: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
286: 	case OperationStage:
287: 		c.Runtime = true
288: 		c.Mutates = true
289: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
290: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
291: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
292: 		c.Runtime = true
293: 		c.Mutates = true
294: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
295: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
296: 	case OperationReviewStart:
297: 		c.Runtime = true
298: 		c.Mutates = true
299: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
300: 		if req.RestartReview {
301: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
302: 		}
303: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
304: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
305: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
306: 		if err != nil {
307: 			return c, err
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
312: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
313: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
314: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
316: 		if req.ForceReview {
317: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
318: 		}
319: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
320: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
321: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
322: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
323: 		}
324: 		c.Runtime = true
325: 		c.Mutates = true
326: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
327: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
328: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
329: 		c.Mutates = true
330: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
331: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
332: 	default:
333: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
334: 	}
335: 	if req.Project != "" {
336: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
337: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
338: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
339: 		} else {
340: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
341: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
342: 		}
343: 	} else {
344: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
345: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
346: 	}
347: 	if c.Mutates {
348: 		if req.Project != "" {
349: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
350: 		} else {
351: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
352: 		}
353: 	} else {
354: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
355: 	}
356: 	if c.Runtime {
357: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
358: 	}
359: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
360: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
361: 	if err != nil {
362: 		return c, err
363: 	}
364: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
365: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
366: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
367: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
368: 	if err != nil {
369: 		return c, err
370: 	}
371: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
372: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
373: 	return c, nil
374: }

376: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
377: 	switch req.Kind {
378: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
379: 	default:
380: 		return nil
381: 	}
382: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
383: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
384: 	}
385: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Suite != "smoke" {
386: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite must be smoke")
387: 	}
388: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQADryRun {
389: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite is valid only for start or dry-run")
390: 	}
391: 	if req.Suite != "" && req.Task != "" {
392: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA suite and shard focus are mutually exclusive")
393: 	}
394: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
395: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
396: 	}
397: 	return nil
398: }

400: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
401: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
402: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
403: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
404: 	if err != nil {
405: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
406: 	}
407: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
408: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
409: 	}
410: 	req = prepared.Request
411: 	if emit == nil {
412: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
413: 	}
414: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
415: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
416: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
417: 	}
418: 	ss := u.sprintService()
419: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
420: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
421: 	switch req.Kind {
422: 	case OperationValidate:
423: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
424: 		switch {
425: 		case req.Study != "":
426: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
427: 		case req.Sprint != "":
428: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
429: 		default:
430: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
431: 		}
432: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
433: 		if err != nil {
434: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
435: 		}
436: 		result.Message = validation.Status
437: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
438: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
439: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
440: 		if err != nil {
441: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
442: 		}
443: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
444: 	case OperationPrompt:
445: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
446: 		if err != nil {
447: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
448: 		}
449: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
450: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
451: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
454: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
455: 		}
456: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
457: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
458: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
459: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
460: 		if err != nil {
461: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
462: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
463: 		}
464: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
465: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
466: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
467: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
468: 		if err != nil {
469: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
470: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
471: 		}
472: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
473: 		result.Message = r.Message
474: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
480: 		if !execute.Available {
481: 			result.Message = execute.Message
482: 		} else {
483: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
484: 		}
485: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
486: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
487: 		if err != nil {
488: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
489: 		}
490: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
491: 		result.Message = r.Message
492: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
493: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
494: 		if err != nil {
495: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
496: 		}
497: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
498: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
499: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
500: 		if err != nil {
501: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
502: 		}
503: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
504: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
505: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
508: 		}
509: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
510: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
511: 	case OperationQAStatus:
512: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
513: 		if err != nil {
514: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
515: 		}
516: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
517: 	case OperationQADryRun:
518: 		if req.Suite == "smoke" {
519: 			smoke, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{DryRun: true})
520: 			if err != nil {
521: 				return failedOperation(result, err)
522: 			}
523: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("smoke suite ready: %s %s", smoke.ScopeKind, smoke.Scope)
524: 			result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(smoke))
525: 			break
526: 		}
527: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
528: 		if err != nil {
529: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
530: 		}
531: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
532: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
533: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
534: 	case OperationQARecover:
535: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
536: 		if err != nil {
537: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
538: 		}
539: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
540: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
541: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
542: 		if err != nil {
543: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
544: 		}
545: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
546: 	default:
547: 		if u.runner == nil {
548: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
549: 		}
550: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
551: 	}
552: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
553: 	return result, nil
554: }

556: func normalizeOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) OperationRequest {
557: 	req.Project = strings.TrimSpace(req.Project)
558: 	req.Sprint = strings.TrimSpace(req.Sprint)
559: 	req.Study = strings.TrimSpace(req.Study)
560: 	req.Stage = strings.TrimSpace(req.Stage)
561: 	req.Task = strings.TrimSpace(req.Task)
562: 	req.Model = strings.TrimSpace(req.Model)
563: 	req.Level = strings.TrimSpace(req.Level)
564: 	req.Suite = strings.TrimSpace(req.Suite)
565: 	req.Test = strings.TrimSpace(req.Test)
566: 	req.Timeout = strings.TrimSpace(req.Timeout)
567: 	req.OverrideRationale = strings.TrimSpace(req.OverrideRationale)
568: 	req.ReviewFocus = normalizedStrings(req.ReviewFocus)
569: 	req.Sources = normalizedStrings(req.Sources)

574: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
575: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
576: 		if value == "" {
577: 			continue
578: 		}
579: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
580: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
581: 		}
582: 		for _, r := range value {
583: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
584: 				continue
585: 			}
586: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
587: 		}
588: 	}
589: 	return nil
590: }

592: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
593: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
594: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
595: 	for _, value := range values {
596: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
597: 		if value == "" {
598: 			continue
599: 		}
600: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
601: 			continue
602: 		}
603: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
604: 		out = append(out, value)
605: 	}
606: 	sort.Strings(out)
607: 	return out
608: }

699: func fingerprintOperationInputs(root, canonical string, inputs []string) (string, error) {
700: 	hash := sha256.New()
701: 	_, _ = hash.Write([]byte(canonical))
702: 	for _, rel := range inputs {
703: 		path := filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(rel))
704: 		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
705: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
706: 			continue
707: 		}
708: 		if err != nil {
709: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("inspect governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
710: 		}
711: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
712: 			return "", fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not be a symbolic link", rel)
713: 		}
714: 		if info.IsDir() {
715: 			var files []string
716: 			if err := filepath.WalkDir(path, func(item string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
717: 				if walkErr != nil {
718: 					return walkErr
719: 				}
720: 				if entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
721: 					return fmt.Errorf("governed input %s must not contain symbolic links", rel)
722: 				}
723: 				if !entry.IsDir() {
724: 					files = append(files, item)
725: 				}
726: 				return nil
727: 			}); err != nil {
728: 				return "", fmt.Errorf("scan governed input %s: %w", rel, err)
729: 			}
730: 			sort.Strings(files)
731: 			for _, item := range files {
732: 				itemRel, _ := filepath.Rel(root, item)
733: 				if err := hashOperationFile(hash, item, filepath.ToSlash(itemRel)); err != nil {
734: 					return "", err
735: 				}
736: 			}
737: 			continue
738: 		}
739: 		if err := hashOperationFile(hash, path, rel); err != nil {
740: 			return "", err
741: 		}
742: 	}
743: 	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash.Sum(nil)), nil
744: }

reasoning_details.text:
Retention deletes events and eventually run rows (tombstone expiry) — operation_aliases presumably have FK cascade on run delete. So aliases live as long as the run row: FullHistory default? Check defaults: DefaultFullHistory / DefaultTombstoneHistory in model.go. Likely 24h/7d etc. So a repeated identical operation is blocked until retention deletes the old run (hours/days). That's still a real usability/correctness issue IF repeating an identical request is legitimate.

But wait — is it legitimate per product contract? The dedup exists to prevent double-execution of the same confirmed operation (double-click). The web dedup key includes a one-time token consumed at prepare → each new prepare gets new token → different digest → no blocking for intentional repeats via web! Web: confirmationDedupKey = sha256(sessionID + NUL + token) where token is freshly minted per preparation. So repeat ops via web work.

TUI: digest = canonical+fingerprint WITHOUT any nonce/token. Repeat of identical op after completion → alias conflict → blocked with "matching durable operation already exists". Is that intended "protection" or a defect? Think: TUI user runs execute-start (no task specified). It completes. User wants next task → same request bytes → blocked. Unless TUI clears Confirmation and re-Prepares... PrepareOperation recomputes fingerprint; if governed inputs unchanged, identical digest again. Blocked until retention expires (FullHistory default?). Let me check defaults.

Also check sprint flow: does TUI execute-start include Task always? sharedOperationRunner Execute uses req.Task; TUI may allow selecting task? OperationRequest.Task set when user picks shard/task. For review-start, Task empty. For study-start, Study ref + dimensions/sources arrays — identical re-run blocked.

Hmm, but hold on — maybe this is deliberate: "one durable operation per exact confirmed input" — the TRD says acceptance is bound to normalized request + current governed-input fingerprint; dedup by digest prevents duplicate execution of the SAME confirmed intent. If the product intends repeat executions, the digest would need a nonce. The web path has one-time tokens; the TUI path doesn't. Asymmetry suggests TUI defect OR TUI intent = strict once-only semantics. Which is it? Look for tests/comments about TUI re-running operations. Search tui tests and workspace docs for alias/dedup semantics ("alias" in TRD).

Let me search the planning workspace for contract statements about operation aliases and re-execution.
